name: WebGPU web 3D renderer with DSL and path tracer

mentions.name: WebGPU web 3D renderer with DSL and path tracer
mentions.description: A WebGPU-based 3D renderer for the web with WebGL fallbacks and a path tracer 'photo mode' for photorealistic rendering. Scenes are created via a built-in DSL rather than 3D models, and the renderer is specifically designed for AI agents writing web 3D content. A desktop-only demo app is available online.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm making a WebGPU renderer with WebGL fallbacks, with a path tracer for 'photo mode', specifically targeting agents writing web 3D things. I'm not especially far into it though. It doesn't use 3D models; there's a DSL for making things.
mentions.author: onion2k
